title: Garment Spec
description: The structured, persisted interpretation of one craft option's tech-pack illustration. Written by tech-pack-interpreter's extract_spec.mjs to <repo>/.craft-pipeline/<productId>/<optionId>/spec.json. This is the single source of truth handed to garment-image-director — nothing downstream may recompute it from raw catalog text.

addr.description: Human-readable path: productId > sectionId > fieldId > optionId.

sourceFile.description: The catalog file this option was read from — also the write-back target once garment-image-qc approves a generation.

part.description: Canonical garment part, e.g. 'jacket-lapel', 'trouser-waistband-width', 'fin-buttonhole'. Drives camera/composition selection downstream.

noun.description: The garment as a photographic subject, e.g. 'navy bespoke suit jacket'.

orientation.description: Which face of the garment the illustration depicts. Never inferred from field naming alone — must be confirmed by actually looking at the illustration (see orientation-rules.md).

wearerPerspective.description: True: left/right in this record mean the wearer's left/right, not the viewer's. Construction facts (e.g. 'adjuster on the outseam') are always recorded from the wearer's perspective; only the photography plan (garment-image-director) converts to viewer's perspective.

confirmedByVisualInspection.description: Must be true before a spec is eligible for generation. False/missing means orientation was guessed from text, not confirmed by reading the image.

absence.description: True when this option is the deliberate ABSENCE of a feature (e.g. 'Ventless', 'No Pocket') — the photo must show a clean area, never a phantom feature.

measured.description: Literal values parsed deterministically from the catalog text. Every value here must be echoed verbatim downstream — nothing may be silently dropped.

flags.description: Binary construction facts, e.g. ['belt loops', 'top stitch']

sides.description: Directional facts stated by the catalog, e.g. ['left'] or ['both']. Never inferred, never combined; a mirror-flipped render is invisible to QC.

attributes.description: Named construction triples, e.g. {feature:'buttonhole', attribute:'method', value:'hand-sewn'}. Locks the property so the prompt states it instead of the model choosing.

supplierCodes.description: The supplier's own value codes where the catalog states them, e.g. ['055T'] — sometimes the only thing distinguishing two options.

unresolved.description: Properties the catalog NAMES but never resolves to a value. Blocks generation; never rendered as a placeholder.

path.description: As stored in the catalog — a web-root path or a remote URL.

disk.description: Resolved local filesystem path, if local.

forbidden.description: Structural negative constraints derived from this exact spec (option isolation, absence guard, front/back lock, exact counts). garment-image-director merges this with its own universal photography negatives when assembling the final prompt.

excluded.description: Non-null means this is a colour/material swatch, out of scope for photo generation.

generate.description: True only when a blueprint exists AND the option is not an excluded swatch.
